Title: draw.io
Description: Adds draw.io diagrams to Umbraco 17 and 18 (Block List/Grid block, standalone editor, and viewer) using hosted diagrams.net. Install AurorisNet.Umbraco.Drawio.Selfhosted instead to bundle the editor locally.

RelatedPackages.Description: Self-hosted offline variant that bundles draw.io locally and includes this package automatically.
